evals.prompt: In an existing Cloudflare Workers TypeScript project using Hono, add a typed KV binding, a JWT-protected /admin route, and a small test using app.request(). Explain which Hono docs you used.
evals.expected_output: A runtime-aware implementation plan and code that uses typed Bindings/Variables, Hono JWT middleware or helper guidance from the local docs, and app.request() for verification.

evals.prompt: Create a Hono RPC example with Zod validation for a posts API and a typed client. Include status-code handling and note any large-app caveats.
evals.expected_output: Server and client snippets based on Hono validation and RPC docs, including exported route types, hc usage, status/global response handling, and IDE performance caveats.

evals.prompt: Review this planned Node.js Hono app structure: routes are grouped in controller classes, CORS is added after routes, and tests call fetch against a running server. Suggest a simpler Hono-native structure.
evals.expected_output: A review grounded in best-practices, middleware ordering, Node.js adapter, and testing docs, recommending app.route/basePath or factory patterns and app.request() where appropriate.
